svg.title: Ygaraty contributor invitation example
svg.desc: A terminal example with a red box around a placeholder contributor link. Open your session link yourself or share it with contributors, then wait for their model weights to load.

g.text: Ygaraty qwen3.5-0.8b · 1 worker · 4,096-token context · 1 chat at a time
